services.name: Quilting by the Lake 2026
services.desc: Welcome to Quilting by the Lake (QBL), a 2-week, internationally recognized quilting event taking place in Geneva, NY, in the heart of the Finger Lakes. Located at the north end of Seneca Lake, the attractive campus provides a wonderful setting for world-class quilting workshops. Classes will be offered in design, techniques, and surface design to suit all quilting styles: traditional, art, or modern. Sign up and be part of our special community, treasured for its creative environment and camaraderie. Quilting by the Lake consists of two 1-week sessions from July 19 to August 1.
